recipes.name: Glowing Popsicles inspired by The Mandalorian
ingredients: 2 oz mangos, peeled + chopped (or 10 frozen mango)
2/3 cup coconut cream (or the cream from 2 cans of full fat coconut milk, strained), chilled
1 tbsp Optional: orange liquor (i.e. Gran Marnier)
instructions: For the Fruit Juice Popsicle

Combine all of the ingredients in the base of a food processor. Process until completely smooth, then strain the mixture. Discard the raspberry seeds. - 6 oz fresh raspberries - 5 ½ oz water - 1 ¾ oz sugar - 1 tbsp lemon juice - ¾ tsp guar gum
Pour the raspberry mixture into a freezer safe popsicle mold. Place a popsicle stick (or glow stick) into each of the popsicles.
Freeze overnight before serving.
For the Frozen Mousse Popsicle

Combine the mango, sugar, water, and lime juice in the base of a food processor. Process until smooth and set aside. - 2 oz mangos peeled + chopped (or 10 frozen mango) - 2 ½ oz sugar - 3 oz water - 2 tbsp lime juice
Add the coconut cream to the blender and blend until thickened. - ⅔ cup coconut cream (or the cream from 2 cans of full fat coconut milk strained), chilled
Pour the mango mixture into a freezer safe popsicle mold. Place a popsicle stick (or glow stick) into each of the popsicles.
Freeze overnight before serving.
For the Brazilian Limeade Popsicle
Slice the limes into 8 segments. - 3 small limes washed + dried
Add the limes, sweetened condensed milk, sugar and ice water to a high powered blender. - 6 oz sweetened condensed milk - 2 tbsp sugar - 9 oz ice water
Blend the mixture for 15 seconds only, the longer you blend, the more bitter the popsicle will be.
Strain the mixture and discard any remaining rind pieces.
Pour the lime mixture into a freezer safe popsicle mold. Place a popsicle stick (or glow stick) into each of the popsicles.
Freeze overnight before serving.
For the Sorbet Popsicle
Combine the water, sugar, and corn syrup in a small saucepot. Bring the mixture to a boil and cook until it reaches 220 °F. Set aside. - 4 oz water - 3 ¾ oz sugar - 2 tbsp light corn syrup

In the base of a food processor, combine the blueberries and lemon juice (and orange liquor if using). Process until smooth. - 15 oz frozen blueberries - 2 tbsp lemon juice - 1 tbsp Optional: orange liquor (i.e. Gran Marnier)
Combine the blueberry mixture and the sugar syrup in a pourable vessel.
Allow the mixture to cool to room temperature (if necessary), then pour it into a freezer safe popsicle mold. Place a popsicle stick (or glow stick) into each of the popsicles.
Freeze overnight before serving.
